name: The Otis household at 1730 Prairie Avenue
head: pa1904_otis_mrs_joseph_e

present_on_scene_date.note: Listed at 1730 Prairie Avenue in the Blue Book for 1904 (canvass begun September 1903) and again in the 1905 edition (canvass begun September 1904), which bracket 1 July 1904. The 1905 list prints: 1730 Mrs. Joseph E. Otis; Mr. & Mrs. John E. Jenkins.

associated_with.note: The Blue Book's Prairie Avenue street list prints the household at 1730, and the 1905 list again. The book gives no date the household came or went, so neither end is dated here.

not_in_this_household.note: WHO IS NOT ON THIS CARD, AND WHY. The Blue Book is a society register: it names the family members who received and were received, prints unmarried daughters only as '& dr.', and names no young children, servants, coachmen, cooks or nurses. The 1900 census (ED 40, T623 roll 245) was read for this card. The three live-in staff it lists at the house on 1 June 1900 are on the card, graded inferred because the count was taken four years before the scene. Left off: Joseph E. Otis (the head in 1900; by 1904 the Blue Book lists his widow, Mrs. Joseph E. Otis); Ralph C. Otis (a married son the 1904 Blue Book does not list at the house); Louise Otis (his wife; not listed in 1904 either). The 1910 census (T624 roll 241, ED 166 and 167) was read for this card's children: the children it lists, and those the Blue Book lists at the number from 1890 to 1911, are on the card with the years each lived here, whether or not they were at home in 1904. A person goes on this card when a source names them, and not before.

persons.name: Mrs. Joseph E. Otis
persons.note: The 1900 census lists Marie P. Otis here as wife, born August 1837, in Ohio (as read), married (ED 40, sheet 1B, line 55, leaf n795).

persons.name: Joseph E. Otis jr.
persons.note: Listed at 1730 under Mr. and Mrs. Joseph E. Otis in the 1890 and 1891 editions; the 'jr.' names him the son of the house. The 1910 census has his mother the mother of eight children, four of them living (ED 166, sheet 6A, line 6, leaf n1439).

persons.name: Ralph C. Otis

born.note: The 1910 census gives age 40 on 15 April 1910, so born about 1869-1870.

persons.note: Listed at 1730 under his parents from 1890, with his wife in 1901, and not in the 1902 to 1910 editions; the 1910 census finds him at home again, as son, aged 40, with his wife Evaleen. Whether he lived here in 1904 is not documented.

persons.name: John E. Jenkins
persons.note: First listed at 1730 in the 1905 edition (canvass begun September 1904); not in the 1904 edition, so whether he was already here on 1 July 1904 is not documented. His relation to Mrs. Otis is not printed.

persons.name: Mrs. John E. Jenkins
persons.note: First listed at 1730 in the 1905 edition, with her husband; see his note. The 1910 census names her Lillian Jenkins and lists her as Mrs. Otis's daughter, aged 49, with her husband and their son Elliott, 19 (ED 166, sheet 6A, lines 9-11).

persons.name: Amelia Sanz

born.note: The census gives December 1872, age 27 on 1 June 1900.

occupation.note: Written as "House maid" in the occupation column on 1 June 1900.

persons.note: Enumerated on 1 June 1900 in the house, as a servant (house maid); born December 1872, in Wisconsin, single. Servants changed places often, so this records who worked here in 1900; no source read says whether this person was still here on 1 July 1904. Part of the name is hard to read on the sheet; this is the best reading.

persons.name: Annie Paulson

born.note: The census gives 1854, age 45 on 1 June 1900.

occupation.note: Written as "Cook" in the occupation column on 1 June 1900.

persons.note: Enumerated on 1 June 1900 in the house, as a servant (cook); born 1854 (the figures are hard to read), in Norway, came to the United States in 1880, single. Servants changed places often, so this records who worked here in 1900; no source read says whether this person was still here on 1 July 1904.

persons.name: John Bailey

born.note: The census gives May 1872, age 27 on 1 June 1900.

occupation.note: Written as "Coachman" in the occupation column on 1 June 1900.

persons.note: Enumerated on 1 June 1900 in the rear building behind the house, as the head of his own household there (coachman); born May 1872, in Maryland, single. Servants changed places often, so this records who worked here in 1900; no source read says whether this person was still here on 1 July 1904. The census records the color column as B.
